tour.title: Service Entry Point & Autonomous Lifecycle
tour.description: JarvisForegroundService keeps J.A.R.V.I.S. persistently active with high priority, initializing AssistantRuntime, SubsystemManager, and Bluetooth SCO audio routing.

tour.title: Always-On Audio Capture & Wake-Word Detection
tour.description: Continuous low-power audio streaming feeds the quantized TFLite DS-CNN engine to detect "Hey Jarvis" hands-free with high precision and low battery impact.

tour.title: Groq Cloud LLM Multi-Step Reasoning & Vision
tour.description: User commands are dispatched to Groq LLM (llama-3.3-70b-versatile or llama-3.2-11b-vision-preview). MultiTaskDecomposer breaks complex goals into sequential sub-plans.

tour.title: Extensible Tools & Android OS Automation
tour.description: ToolRegistry registers over 47 specialized execution tools for launching apps, controlling volume, toggling flashlight, reading notifications, and navigating via AccessibilityService.

tour.title: Google Stitch Material 3 HUD & Reactive UI
tour.description: Adhering to cyber-slate aesthetics, the UI features an interactive Arc Reactor orb (JarvisOrbView), live microphone waveform rendering, and modular dashboard controls.

tour.title: On-Device Vector RAG & Persistent Memory
tour.description: On-device vector database stores past user interactions and context, enabling semantic retrieval and personalized assistant responses.
